source_name: NBS – Štatistické údaje (statistics portal root)
why_relevant: Top-level hub of the Slovak central bank's statistics portal; enumerates every statistical domain (financial institutions, financial markets, balance of payments, quarterly financial accounts, macro indicators, SDDS Plus, OpenStats, reporting-entity information). Best single entry point for snowballing all NBS-created series and for detecting new datasets/URL moves.

source_name: NBS – Statistics (English mirror of the statistics portal)
why_relevant: English-language mirror of the same portal tree; useful for term mapping (sk<->en) and for machine-readable navigation where Slovak labels are ambiguous. Coverage appears near-parity but some legacy subpages are Slovak-only, so both trees must be tracked.

source_name: NBS OpenStats – interactive dataset/dashboard platform
why_relevant: NBS's newer open-data layer: interactive tables and charts with search, filter and download, explicitly framed as a supplement to static outputs and with a growing dataset roster (currently banks/loans/deposits dashboard observed). This is the most likely future home of machine-friendly downloads of NBS series, including any payment-side datasets added later.

source_name: NBS – Štatistické údaje peňažných finančných inštitúcií (MFI statistics)
why_relevant: Core monetary/banking statistics set: statistical balance sheet of banks (monthly from 1998), assets & liabilities balance (monthly from 1999), profit-and-loss (monthly from 2018), currency and non-resident-country breakdowns (quarterly). This is the authoritative long time-series backbone for Slovak banking-sector sizing.

source_name: NBS – Časové rady vybraných ukazovateľov (time series of selected indicators)
why_relevant: Explicit long time-series product within the MFI statistics branch — the closest thing on the NBS site to a curated 'data warehouse' export for headline banking indicators. Highest-value structure for trend analysis with minimal re-assembly.

source_name: NBS – Menová štatistika peňažných finančných inštitúcií (monetary statistics overview)
why_relevant: Analytical/commentary layer over the raw MFI series; gives NBS's own reading of monetary aggregates, loans and deposits development. Useful for methodology notes and for catching definitional breaks in the series.

source_name: NBS – Úroková štatistika (interest rate statistics)
why_relevant: MIR (MFI interest rate) statistics for Slovak banks — new business and outstanding amounts. Context series for banking-market economics that frame card/consumer-credit pricing and bank profitability.

source_name: NBS – Prehľad o vývoji peňažného sektora (banking sector development overview)
why_relevant: Recurring aggregate overview of the money/banking sector — a compact release that often carries headline figures ahead of full dataset publication, useful as an early signal and cross-check.

source_name: NBS – SIPS retail payment system statistics
why_relevant: Volume and value of transactions processed in the NBS-operated SIPS retail payment system since 1 Jan 2003, split SKK era (2003-2008), EUR era (2009-2013) and SEPA era (2013-present, SCT and SDD), available summary/monthly/daily and split domestic vs cross-border. This is a genuinely NBS-created transaction series — the densest non-card payment-volume source in the cell.

source_name: NBS – TARGET services statistics (Štatistické údaje)
why_relevant: Slovak leg of the Eurosystem TARGET large-value settlement service; NBS publishes national participation statistics. Complements SIPS to give the full picture of settlement traffic in Slovakia.

source_name: NBS – Platobné karty / Payment cards (payment instruments page)
why_relevant: NBS's own narrative page on payment cards in Slovakia. It carries headline figures NBS chooses to publicise (e.g. active Visa/Mastercard cards, card share of cashless payments) and defines NBS terminology, but it is commentary rather than a dataset — no downloadable card/ATM/POS tables were found on it.

source_name: NBS – Elektronické bankovníctvo a platobné karty (consumer-facing explainer)
why_relevant: Slovak-language definitional page describing what is counted as a payment card, ATM withdrawal, POS/terminal payment and (since 2019) mobile payments. Valuable as the local-language glossary anchor for aligning collected series to NBS definitions; also states that card issuing/acquiring statistics are compiled from bank reporting.

source_name: NBS – Štatistický bulletin (Statistical Bulletin) + publication schedule
why_relevant: NBS's consolidated recurring statistical publication with annual editions (2022, 2024 editions observed) and a published release schedule. Gives a stable, citable snapshot of the full NBS statistical apparatus and is often the easiest way to recover series definitions and historical revisions.

source_name: NBS – Mesačný bulletin NBS (NBS Monthly Bulletin)
why_relevant: Monthly analytical bulletin carrying NBS commentary and selected statistical annexes; useful for early narrative signals and for dating series revisions. Archive runs back at least to 2011.

source_name: NBS – Data release calendar / Kalendár zverejňovania údajov
why_relevant: Publication calendar for NBS statistical releases. Operationally decisive for a long-term collector: it lets fetches be scheduled against the actual release dates instead of blind polling, and flags when a release slips.

source_name: NBS – SDDS Plus data categories (Údajové kategórie SDDS)
source_subtype: IMF SDDS Plus national summary data page
why_relevant: IMF Special Data Dissemination Standard Plus national summary page — Slovakia has participated in SDDS since Aug 1996, jointly with the Statistical Office and Ministry of Finance. Gives a standardised, machine-comparable header set of macro-financial series with committed release timeliness.

source_name: NBS – Makroekonomická databáza (macroeconomic database)
why_relevant: Interactive time-series database over eight indicator families (GDP, labour market, prices, public sector, balance of payments, external environment, monthly indicators, financial market), with A/Q/M frequencies and built-in transformations, updated the day after each indicator release. The closest NBS equivalent to a queryable data warehouse front end; note it aggregates Eurostat/ECB/EC/OECD/IMF inputs alongside NBS-created data.

source_name: NBS – Štatistický zberový portál (ŠZP) / Statistics Collection Portal
why_relevant: The upstream reporting machinery: the portal through which banks and other reporting entities submit statistical returns to NBS. Its report templates and code lists reveal exactly which fields (card counts, terminal counts, transaction volumes) NBS collects — i.e. what data exists even when it is not published. Submission side is authenticated; the public layer is the documentation.

source_name: NBS – Metodické informácie (statistical methodology)
why_relevant: Methodological notes governing NBS statistical compilation. Essential for correctly interpreting breaks, scope changes and definitional shifts in card/terminal/monetary series over a multi-year tracking horizon.

source_name: NBS – Číselníky a registre (code lists and registers)
why_relevant: Reference code lists and registers underpinning NBS statistical reporting — the join keys needed to link reported series to institutions and instrument types. Includes the entity register front end (subjekty.nbs.sk) used to enumerate licensed banks.

source_name: NBS – Právny rámec NBS a ECB pre štatistiku (statistics legal framework)
why_relevant: The NBS/ECB legal instruments that mandate statistical reporting (including the ECB payments statistics regulation lineage). Determines what must be reported and published, and therefore what can be expected to exist and persist over time.

source_name: NBS – Financial sector analytical data (FS data)
why_relevant: Analytical dataset release attached to NBS financial-stability work; a second, differently-structured NBS data outlet that sometimes exposes sector aggregates not present in the main statistics tree. Worth tracking as a parallel channel.

source_name: NBS – Súhrnné štatistické údaje (supervisory disclosure aggregate statistics)
why_relevant: Aggregate supervisory statistics published under the EU supervisory disclosure framework — a distinct, legally mandated NBS statistical output covering the banking sector's prudential aggregates. Complements the monetary statistics with a supervisory view.

source_name: ECB Data Portal – Payments statistics (PSD/PCP/PAY), Slovakia reference area
source_subtype: supranational statistical data warehouse hosting NBS-reported series
why_relevant: This is where NBS-compiled Slovak payment statistics actually land in machine-readable form. NBS reports card counts, POS/ATM terminal counts and card transaction volumes/values to the ECB under the payments statistics regulation; the ECB Data Portal exposes them as datasets (PSD, PCP 'card payments and cash withdrawals using cards incl. fraud', PAY key indicators, payment-card-accepting-devices category) with an API, semi-annual collection and quarterly high-level indicators. For the card/ATM/POS topics in this cell, this is the practical primary retrieval channel for NBS-created series.

source_name: ECB payments statistics press releases (half-yearly), Slovak country tables
source_subtype: statistical press release with country annexes
why_relevant: Half-yearly ECB payments statistics release with country tables including Slovakia; provides the release cadence, revision notes and a human-readable cross-check against API pulls of the NBS-reported card/terminal series.

source_name: NBS legacy site (www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/…) – historical statistics and annual report chapters
why_relevant: The pre-migration NBS website still serves historical PDFs, including annual-report chapters dedicated to 'E. PLATOBNÝ STYK' (payment system) that carry older card/ATM/POS and payment-volume tables not present in the modern site tree. Important for reconstructing long histories before the site redesign; also proves that some legacy paths (e.g. www.nbs.sk/sk/statisticke-udaje/platobny-styk) now 404 while the /_img/documents/ file store persists.

source_name: NBS – Publikácie (master publications hub / rozcestník)
why_relevant: Single authoritative index of every NBS narrative publication series (annual report, financial stability report, analytical comments, quick comments, macroprudential commentary, data insights, blogs, Biatec archive, discontinued series). Best snowball root for the whole non-statistical layer of NBS output on payments and cash.

source_name: NBS – Výročná správa (Annual Report)
why_relevant: Annual narrative report contains dedicated chapters on issuance of banknotes and coins (emisia bankoviek a mincí), cash circulation (hotovostný peňažný obeh), and payment systems (platobný styk / SIPS, TARGET) — with commentary and charts not present in raw statistics tables.

source_name: NBS – Správa o finančnej stabilite (Financial Stability Report)
why_relevant: Semi-annual flagship narrative report on the Slovak financial sector; interprets banking-sector, retail-payment and household-behaviour trends, and carries analytical boxes that frequently touch digitalisation of payments and cash demand.
